# ntlpanel

**Nighttime lights to analysis-ready panels for econometrics.**

`ntlpanel` turns nighttime lights rasters into balanced unit-by-period
panels. Every observation records how much of the unit was actually
observed. The steps that usually happen silently in a script become
explicit and recorded:

- **Sensor continuity.** NOAA ended Suomi NPP data delivery on 2
  November 2026.
  [`ntl_splice()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_splice.md)
  puts Suomi NPP (`VNP46`) and NOAA-20 (`VJ146`) on one scale and
  reports level shifts per unit, optionally per calendar month.
- **Coverage.**
  [`ntl_extract()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_extract.md)
  reports `share_valid`, `share_masked` and `mean_obs` for each unit and
  period, and keeps “dark” (0) separate from “unobserved” (`NA`).
  [`ntl_gapfill()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_gapfill.md)
  applies a documented rule to high-latitude summer gaps and flags the
  cells at risk.
- **Units and design.**
  [`ntl_crosswalk()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_crosswalk.md)
  moves official statistics between boundary vintages, for example
  Kazakhstan’s 2022 regions.
  [`ntl_exposure()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_exposure.md)
  assigns distance rings and first-treatment dates for staggered
  difference-in-differences designs.

## Installation

Install the development version from GitHub:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("iskakovs/ntlpanel")
# or: remotes::install_github("iskakovs/ntlpanel")
```

The package depends on `terra`, `sf`, `exactextractr`, `httr2` and
`hdf5r`. Black Marble `.h5` files are read with `hdf5r` rather than
through GDAL, so tile orientation does not depend on the GDAL version.

## Quick start (offline, synthetic data)

``` r

library(ntlpanel)
ex <- ntl_example()                               # synthetic files + polygons

m    <- ntl_files(ex$dir, "eog_vnl_monthly")      # manifest of local files
long <- ntl_extract(m, ex$units_old, id_col = "district", min_obs = 2)
sp   <- ntl_splice(long, from = "eog_vnl_monthly_npp", to = "eog_vnl_monthly_j01")
ntl_splice_report(sp)                             # level shift per district

p <- ntl_panel(sp, min_share_valid = 0.5)         # balanced, log1p outcome, t index
p <- ntl_gapfill(p, rule = "interp", units = ex$units_old, lat_threshold = 49)

e <- ntl_exposure(ex$units_old, ex$sites, rings = c(50, 100, 200),
                  id_col = "district", site_time_col = "start")
```

## Real data: Black Marble for Kazakhstan

``` r

# One-off: put your NASA Earthdata token in ~/.Renviron as EARTHDATA_TOKEN=...
regions <- sf::st_read("kz_adm1_2022.gpkg")
ntl_tiles(regions)                                # h22-h26 x v03-v04

m_snpp <- ntl_fetch("VNP46A4", aoi = regions, start = 2014, end = 2025)
m_j01  <- ntl_fetch("VJ146A4", aoi = regions, start = 2018, end = 2025)
long   <- ntl_extract(rbind(m_snpp, m_j01), regions, id_col = "region")
sp     <- ntl_splice(long, from = "VNP46A4", to = "VJ146A4")
p      <- ntl_panel(sp)
```

Downloads go to a temporary folder unless you set a permanent one with
`NTLPANEL_CACHE` in `~/.Renviron` (see
[`?ntl_cache_dir`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_cache_dir.md)).
For monthly data, fetch and extract one year at a time and call
[`ntl_cache_clear()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_cache_dir.md)
in between. A monthly tile is about 50-130 MB.

## Functions

| Step | Functions |
|----|----|
| Find data | [`ntl_sources()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_sources.md), [`ntl_tiles()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_tiles.md), [`ntl_available()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_available.md) |
| Get data | [`ntl_fetch()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_fetch.md) (LAADS: VNP46A3/A4, VJ146A3/A4), [`ntl_files()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_files.md) (EOG VNL, harmonized series, local `.h5`) |
| Read and mask | [`ntl_read()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_read.md), [`ntl_read_bm()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_read_bm.md), [`ntl_mask()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_mask.md) |
| Extract | [`ntl_extract()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_extract.md), [`ntl_aggregate()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_aggregate.md) |
| Panel | [`ntl_splice()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_splice.md), [`ntl_splice_report()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_splice_report.md), [`ntl_panel()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_panel.md), [`ntl_gapfill()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_gapfill.md) |
| Design | [`ntl_exposure()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_exposure.md), [`ntl_crosswalk()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_crosswalk.md), [`ntl_apply_crosswalk()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_apply_crosswalk.md) |
| Utilities | [`ntl_cache_dir()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_cache_dir.md), [`ntl_cache_info()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_cache_dir.md), [`ntl_cache_clear()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_cache_dir.md), [`ntl_token()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_cache_dir.md), [`ntl_example()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_example.md) |

## Supported products

| id | What | Access |
|----|----|----|
| `VNP46A3`, `VNP46A4` | Black Marble monthly/annual, Suomi NPP (to Oct 2026) | [`ntl_fetch()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_fetch.md), token |
| `VJ146A3`, `VJ146A4` | Black Marble monthly/annual, NOAA-20 | [`ntl_fetch()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_fetch.md), token |
| `eog_vnl_monthly`, `eog_vnl_annual` | EOG VIIRS Nighttime Lights (npp, j01) with `cf_cvg` coverage | free EOG account, then [`ntl_files()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_files.md) |
| `dmsp_viirs_li` | Li et al. (2020) harmonized DMSP-VIIRS, DN scale | figshare, [`ntl_files()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_files.md) |
| `viirs_like_chen` | Chen et al. (2021) extended VIIRS-like series | Harvard Dataverse, [`ntl_files()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_files.md) |
| `world_nightlights_regan` | Regan et al. corrected 1992-2023 series | GitHub, [`ntl_files()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_files.md) |

## Related packages

`ntlpanel` builds on existing tools rather than replacing them:

| Package | What it does | How ntlpanel differs |
|----|----|----|
| [blackmarbler](https://worldbank.github.io/blackmarbler/) (CRAN, World Bank) | Downloads Black Marble tiles from LAADS, mosaics them and computes zonal statistics | Also reads the NOAA-20 `VJ146` products (blackmarbler accepted only Suomi NPP product ids at the time of writing). Adds per-observation coverage diagnostics, cross-sensor splicing, gap rules, balanced panels and boundary crosswalks. Use blackmarbler for the daily products (`VNP46A1/A2`), which ntlpanel does not cover. |
| [nightlightstats](https://github.com/JakobMie/nightlightstats) (GitHub) | DMSP and VIIRS statistics per GADM region | Covers Black Marble and EOG products with coverage counts, and makes panels with any boundaries |
| Rnightlights | DMSP/VIIRS download and zonal statistics | Archived on CRAN since 2019 |
| [rgee](https://github.com/r-spatial/rgee) | General interface to Google Earth Engine through Python | No Python or Earth Engine account needed; focused on nighttime lights panels |
| [exactextractr](https://github.com/isciences/exactextractr), [terra](https://github.com/rspatial/terra), [sf](https://github.com/r-spatial/sf) | Raster and vector building blocks | ntlpanel uses them for reading, masking and exact zonal statistics |

## Citation

Run `citation("ntlpanel")` for the citation of the package. Please also
cite the data products you use (see the `url` column of
[`ntl_sources()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_sources.md)).

## Contributing

Bug reports and pull requests are welcome; see
[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/CONTRIBUTING.md).
Never paste your NASA Earthdata token into an issue.

## Status and validation

Version 0.1.0.9000 passes `R CMD check` and its test suite, which runs
offline on synthetic rasters, HDF5 fixtures and mocked LAADS responses.
It has also been run against live NASA data: a validation over
Kazakhstan (November 2026) downloaded about 300 Black Marble tiles,
confirmed that tiles are read the right way up, and compared Suomi NPP
with NOAA-20 for 14 regions (annual, 2018-2025) and 7 regions (monthly,
2024). Findings that matter beyond Kazakhstan:

- **NOAA-20 reads darker than Suomi NPP.** Region-specific factors
  ranged from 0.79 to 1.01 (median 0.87) and were stable across years
  (`ratio_cv` 0.07-0.13). Switching sensors without splicing would
  create a spurious drop of about 13%; annual region-specific ratios
  correct it well.
- **Monthly data at high latitude have structural gaps.** Snow-free
  composites lose most of November-March to snow cover, and north of
  about 50 N June has almost no usable nights. In the remaining months
  the month-to-month ratio between sensors was unstable in northern
  regions, so prefer annual or growing-season aggregates there and check
  `share_valid` by month before modelling.
- **`by_month = TRUE` needs several years of overlap.** With one year,
  each calendar-month factor rests on a single month per unit.

The script is in
`system.file("scripts", "validate_splice_kz.R", package = "ntlpanel")`;
it runs with any region boundaries and can be limited to a few tiles and
years.

## Roadmap

- Optional Google Earth Engine back-end for server-side zonal
  statistics.
- NOAA-21 products once they are available on LAADS.
- Network distances in
  [`ntl_exposure()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_exposure.md)
  (via `dodgr`).
- H3 grid helpers built on `h3o`.

# Package index

## Find data

- [`ntl_sources()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_sources.md)
  : Supported nighttime lights products
- [`ntl_tiles()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_tiles.md)
  : Black Marble tiles covering an area of interest
- [`ntl_available()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_available.md)
  : Check which periods and tiles are available on NASA LAADS

## Get data

- [`ntl_fetch()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_fetch.md)
  : Download Black Marble tiles from NASA LAADS
- [`ntl_files()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_files.md)
  : Index nighttime lights files you already have
- [`ntl_cache_dir()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_cache_dir.md)
  [`ntl_cache_info()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_cache_dir.md)
  [`ntl_cache_clear()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_cache_dir.md)
  [`ntl_token()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_cache_dir.md)
  : Cache directory, cache management and credentials

## Read and mask

- [`ntl_read()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_read.md)
  : Read one period of a manifest as a raster
- [`ntl_read_bm()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_read_bm.md)
  : Read a Black Marble HDF5 tile
- [`ntl_mask()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_mask.md)
  : Mask low-quality, under-observed and gas-flare pixels

## Extract

- [`ntl_extract()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_extract.md)
  : Extract nighttime lights for many periods
- [`ntl_aggregate()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_aggregate.md)
  : Zonal statistics with coverage diagnostics

## Build panels

- [`ntl_splice()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_splice.md)
  : Splice two sensors into one consistent series
- [`ntl_splice_report()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_splice_report.md)
  : Diagnostics of a splice
- [`ntl_panel()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_panel.md)
  : Build a balanced, analysis-ready panel
- [`ntl_gapfill()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_gapfill.md)
  : Handle missing and low-coverage observations explicitly

## Design variables

- [`ntl_exposure()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_exposure.md)
  : Distance-ring treatment exposure
- [`ntl_crosswalk()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_crosswalk.md)
  : Crosswalk between two boundary vintages
- [`ntl_apply_crosswalk()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_apply_crosswalk.md)
  : Apply a boundary crosswalk to tabular data

## Example data

- [`ntl_example()`](https://iskakovs.github.io/ntlpanel/reference/ntl_example.md)
  : Synthetic example data
